charts.title: K2-376 b: orbits around K2-376
charts.description: The orbits of K2-376's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-376 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Christiansen et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163..244C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CHRISTIANSEN_ET_AL_2022): P 5.776475 d

charts.title: K2-376 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-376 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 117414377, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 224 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 353 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 224 min late; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 118 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
